explanation: The AI response identifies Shirley Chisholm as the first nominated African American presidential candidate and states her spouse was Conrad Chisholm. However, Frederick Douglass (nominated in 1888) was married to Helen Pitts Douglass (or Anna Murray-Douglass), so the response identifies the wrong person.
